verdict.rationale: No documented bulk-export or offboarding feature appears in the evidence. Data could plausibly be pulled out programmatically: Okta's Admin Management APIs are exposed through the official MCP server (listing users, apps and login events), and SCIM gives an open, standard schema and REST API for users and groups. Event hooks also stream events outbound over HTTPS. Missing for 10: an explicit full-data export capability, documented open export formats covering all data types (policies, apps, logs), migration or offboarding guidance, and independent corroboration that leaving with complete data works.
